Name: Haley's Pregnancy
Author: cptnmatruz
Description:
[size=4]Haley is my favourite bachelorette, so I decided to create a mod that would tell the story of the character development she would go through when becoming a mother and forming a family. As well as a new point of view for her regarding her family relationships and her place in the community.

This mod adds a pregnant Haley sprite which will display when she and the farmer are expecting a baby; There's also a winter outfit for her.

[u]Haley will get pregnant regardless of the Farmer's gender. She uses a sperm donor if you select the config option HaleyUsesIVF.
[/u]
As with real life, pregnancy involves a lot of changes for the expecting mother, so Haley's tastes will change and she will crave a lot of sweet food, she will also be shown to have mood swings.
[/size]

[b][size=5]Configuration:[/size][/b]
[size=4]HaleyUsesIVF: If True, Haley will use IVF/sperm donor, regardless of the Farmer's gender. Defaults to False.[/size]

[size=4][u]Note: Pregnancy in SV takes 14 in-game days, so you have that time to see the events for each pregnancy. For all events it needs to be a non-festival day. To start with the event cutscenes it is necessary that you don't have children in your save. You can either start a new game or turn your existing children to doves.[/u][/size]
[b][size=5]Events during Haley's first pregnancy:[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Event 1:[/size][/b][spoiler]Haley delivers the news to Emily[/spoiler]Enter Emily's House at any time.
[b][size=4]Event 2: [/size][/b][spoiler]Check-up with Harvey[/spoiler]One day after event 1 enter Harvey's clinic between 11 AM and 2 PM.
[b][size=4]Event 3: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley and Alex[/spoiler]One day after event 1 enter the town between 4 PM and 7 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 4: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's midnight food craving[/spoiler]One day after event 1 enter the farmhouse after 10 PM on a sunny day and at least 300 gold.
[b][size=4]Event 5: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley, Penny, and the children[/spoiler]One day after event 2 enter the farm between 10 AM and 2 PM ﻿on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 6: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley and Emily have a fight[/spoiler]One day after event 5 enter the farm between 10 AM and 2 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 7: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley and Emily reconcile[/spoiler]One day after event 6 enter the farmhouse between 10 AM and 6 PM a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 8: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's Baby Shower - Part 1: Emily's idea[/spoiler]One day after event 7, read letter from Emily and enter her house.
[b][size=4]Event 9: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's Baby Shower - Part 2: Catering for the Baby Shower[/spoiler]After event 8 enter the Saloon.
[b][size=4]Event 10: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's Baby Shower - Part 3: Procure flower arrangements[/spoiler]After event 8 enter Pierre's shop.
[b][size=4]Event 11 (Optional): [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's Baby Shower - Part 4: Procure special flowers[/spoiler]After event 8, if the bus has been repaired, enter Sandy's shop.
[b][size=4]Event 12 (Optional): [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's Baby Shower - Preparations finished (With bus)[/spoiler]If all events 9, 10 & 11 have been seen, one day after the last of these, enter the town on a sunny day between 1 PM and 7 PM.
[b][size=4]Event 13: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's Baby Shower[/spoiler]After reading letter received from Emily or seeing event 12 and receiving her letter afterwards, enter the town on a sunny day between 2 PM and 7 PM.

[b][size=5][youtube]FAVFpgONLDE[/youtube]
[/size][/b][size=5]Video of First Pregnancy Events by Ahstia Summers.[/size]

[b][size=5]Events during Haley's second pregnancy:[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Event 14:[/size][/b][spoiler]Second pregnancy - Check up with Harvey[/spoiler]This event requires having seen event 13; After Haley becomes pregnant for the second time, enter the farmhouse between 10 AM and 3 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 15: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley and Alex - Part 2[/spoiler]One day after event 14 enter the town between 2 PM and 6 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 16: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley and Maru[/spoiler]One day after event 14 enter the farmhouse between 8 PM and 10 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 17: [/size][/b][spoiler]Auntie Emily[/spoiler]One day after event 16 enter the town between 10 AM and 2 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 18: [/size][/b][spoiler]The Wizard's warning[/spoiler]As soon a Haley becomes pregnant for the second time, you will receive a letter from the Wizard, after reading it, enter the Wizard's tower.
[b][size=4]Event 19: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley hospitalized[/spoiler]This event requires events 17 and 18 to be seen, it can trigger on the same day as event 18, but it needs at least one day to have passed since event 17. Enter the town after 6 PM.
[b][size=4]Event 20: [/size][/b][spoiler]Krobus' finding[/spoiler]It's possible to trigger this event after Haley gave birth to the second child. You need to have seen event 19, have at least 8 hearts with Krobus, received the dark sign recipe in the mail from him, and completed the magic ink quest. With these fulfilled, you will receive a letter from Krobus; go to the sewers after reading it.
[b][size=4]Event 20 (SVE version): [/size][/b][spoiler]Krobus' finding - SVE version[/spoiler]This version requires SVE to be installed, it has the same conditions as the normal version of event 20, in addition to having seen the Goblin's 10 heart event.
[b][size=4]Event 21: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley and Penny's past[/spoiler]After event 19, enter the farmhouse after 8 PM.
[b][size=4]Event 22: [/size][/b][spoiler]A call from Harvey[/spoiler]After event 19 enter the farmhouse between 2 PM and 6 PM.
[b][size=4]Event 23: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley, Jodi and Marnie[/spoiler]One day after event 21 enter the town between 12 PM and 6 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Event 24: [/size][/b][spoiler]Penny evaluates first child[/spoiler]One day after event 23 enter the town between 8 AM and 6 PM.
[b][size=4]Event 25: [/size][/b][spoiler]Haley's book reading[/spoiler]One day after 24, read letter from Penny and enter the museum between 3 PM and 6 PM on a sunny day.
[b][size=4]Final Event: [/size][/b][spoiler]Family vacation[/spoiler]One day after event 25 enter the farmhouse between 9 AM and 6 PM.

[b][size=5]Known Issues:[/size][/b]
[size=4]A few users have reported issues when they have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]Polyamory Sweet[/url] installed. I've talked with the mod's author, ApryllForever, and she suggests giving the Aine flower to Haley before she becomes pregnant, in order to set her as the primary spouse, this so that the pregnant appearance and events become enabled.[/size][size=4]
[/size]
